sql: SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as boats, SUM(yt) as total_yt, SUM(anglers) as total_anglers, ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 80 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, cls LIMIT 50

sql: SELECT boat, fish_date_doy, cls, SUM(yt) as total_yt, SUM(anglers) as total_anglers, ROUND(CAST(SUM(yt) AS FLOAT) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 82 AND cls = 'three_quarter' GROUP BY boat, fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC LIMIT 30
